limitations: Regional rectilinear WGS84 grids only; curvilinear/projected grids require a separately reviewed adapter.
Conservative masks do not resolve local coastal hazards, tides or navigation channels.
Samples and route extrema do not guarantee conditions between samples.
Forecast cycles, valid times and received times are separate; SST is a daily analysis, not a forecast.
A single retained download does not establish provider cadence, uptime or public scientific release approval.
